text:
Tom H: PR #459 (migration guide + JS SDK snippet) is ready. Netlify preview exists but assets are served from `/static/<hash>/` and some links in the guide point to `/assets/*` -> 404s. Planning to merge in the Mon maintenance window 2026-04-13 00:30 UTC unless anyone objects. Can infra or a reviewer confirm preview and advise fix?

Netlify Bot: [auto] Deploy queued for PR #459 63; preview: https://deploy-preview-459--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63; status: failed (2 asset 404s; hashed static paths).

docs-bot: CI: md-lint: pass; linkcheck: 3 broken internal links reported (assets and one anchor).

Priya N: I can take content review. The broken links are likely from using absolute `/assets/...` paths while mkdocs build fingerprints assets under `/static/<hash>/...`. Either reference asset from `docs/` root or use relative paths.

Sam T: Local repro steps that usually catch this:
```
git checkout pr/459
pipenv install --dev
mkdocs build
python -m http.server --directory site 8000
# open the preview and inspect generated HTML for asset paths
```
If you want to mirror Netlify hashing, run the real static build and check `site/` directory structure. Also run `markdown-link-check` locally to catch broken anchors.

Leah M: Quick pragmatic fix: copy the small images/icons into `docs/assets/` and reference them relatively (e.g., `../assets/logo.svg`) from the page. For bigger files we should update the build config to not fingerprint those specific assets.

Tom H: Pushed `fix/assets-paths` with copied assets and updated links to relative paths. Redeploying. Will keep the merge slot but can move it if this still flakes.

Netlify Bot: [auto] Redeploy finished 63; preview up: https://deploy-preview-459--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63; status: success. linkcheck: pass.

Priya N: Reviewing now. Left a small nit on the example snippet (return the client from the init function so copy/paste works). Also requested two reviewers for approval before merge.

Sam T: Added a short local checklist comment to the PR:
1) `mkdocs serve` for dev iteration
2) `mkdocs build && python -m http.server --directory site 8000` to match static output
3) run `markdown-link-check` locally
4) validate code samples in a REPL/sandbox

Leah M: Approved. :white_check_mark: Content LGTM after nit.

Tom H: I addressed the nit and pushed. Scheduling merge for 2026-04-13 00:30 UTC maintenance window. Release note added: "docs: fix asset paths and update migration guide snippet". Will post here after merge.

docs-bot: Reminder: please include the local-checklist in the PR description for future authors.

Tom H: Done. Merged in the window, closing thread.
